## Purpose
Restores the `foreach_point` commits that were reverted so the nightly 1M AMIP could compile.

- #4785 (`foreach_point` in `set_sgs_moments_and_cloud_fraction!`), reverted in #4863
- #4769 (`foreach_point` in `set_cloud_fraction!`), reverted in #4864

The compile failure was introduced in CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2650 and came from the recursive `DataScope(::Broadcasted)` implementation. It was fixed in CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2668 and released in ClimaCore v1.0.3 (CliMA/ClimaCore.jl#2671). ClimaAtmos already requires `ClimaCore = "1.0.3"` (#4868).

## Content
- Cherry-picks the original commits from #4785 and #4769.
- Resolves conflicts with #4869

ConstantTqCorrelation (default, bitwise unchanged) or DiagnosedTqCorrelation, which fills p.precomputed.ᶜcorr_Tq from T′q′ = vertical closure cross term + geometric cross term ∇_h θ_li · ∇_h q_tot (same Richardson weight and lumped element restriction as the variances), transformed to the T basis, rescaled with the σ_q bound and clamped by the provisional parameter sgs_correlation_max. The quadrature, microphysics and diagnostics read the per-cell ᶜcorr_Tq instead of the constant; the env_q_tot_temperature_{covariance,correlation} diagnostics report the sampled values.
